diagnosed_gaps: New source finding: SetBallPosition (4738-4764) and SetBallVelocity (4770-4807) overwrite both mNew and mOld vectors. Evolve (429-639) stores computed results into mOldPos/mOldVel before publication then swaps them per body. Earlier callbacks can therefore replace a later pending result; an immutable PreparedMotion replay is semantically wrong even if delivered in body order. The current metadata/snapshots lack this mutable source scratch/previous pose owner.

AddBall has distinct source initialization: a newly created ball sets mOldPos=mNewPos-dt*mNewVel and mOldVel=mNewVel; replacement updates new vectors while retaining old vectors. Do not initialize all old poses to current pose or reset them on replacement.

Source dispatches only moved missiles after pose swap, angle update and partition reinsertion; the delta-squared gate is <0.1. Dead/moribund/mushroom paths skip dispatch. Generic end-of-world collision callbacks would change behavior.

Iterative locations append into mCollisions only at this late moved-missile phase; source-owned gradient contacts are already present before angles. Master adds self collision if absolute-ID owner is missing, cloaked, or outside the missile bubble when that bubble is not -1.

DispatchCollisions captures list size once, preserves order/duplicates, rereads each ID and LastC immediately before each callback, ignores newly appended entries beyond captured size, reports host error then continues. Shrinking below captured size is unsafe original behavior and requires explicit domain handling.

Current advance_one_tick_with_motion publishes all poses before callbacks. Exact reentrancy requires a per-body publication continuation and preventing Avian from exposing later planned poses early; reuse current callback/continuation owner and unlock/borrow boundaries.
